・[ ] To provide a technical specification document of how it is possible to integrate treasury swaps for DAOs.

Abstract
The DAO Treasury Swap functionality allows DAO members to propose and vote on swapping some of the tokens from the DAO-managed treasury on a Cardano decentralized exchange without any custodial or trusted parties.
Implementation
A DAO-managed treasury allows for proposals to be created that initiate arbitrary withdrawals that can also include datum in one or more of the outputs. The Token Swap Proposal Effect will be a specialized version of a treasury withdrawal that will create a swap order on DEX batching address.
A DAO member will select how much of a given token they want to swap, and decide on the usual swap order parameters like accepted price, slippage, etc. After the proposal is created, DAO members can vote on the proposal as they would for any other Agora proposal.
Limitations
Because of Cardano’s limited composability, the DEX to be integrated with a treasury token swap system must match the following criteria:
・Use of batchers
・Ability to attach output datum to the swap output

(1) is not strictly necessary but it makes implementation of the protocol simpler. Also, every Cardano DEX is already using a batching model, so this is not a limitation for the proposal. (2) is more restrictive - because all script-owned UTxOs on Cardano must have some datum, it is necessary to instruct a batcher to include it in the swap output, otherwise swapped tokens would be unspendable.
